title: This Tata Group stock plunged 10% a day after rallying 19% post Q2 results. Do you own?
summary: Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) shares plunged on Friday, giving up some gains after rallying 19% in the previous session following its Q2 results. The stock fell to Rs 34.24 on the NSE. The company reported a net loss of Rs 59 crore in Q2 FY27, narrowing from Rs 321 crore a year earlier and Rs 72 crore in the previous quarter. Despite the improvement, the stock has declined over 30% in 2026 so far and 59% in three years.

title: Broader markets crash! Small, midcap indices tumble up to 4%. Why analysts are sounding the alarm
summary: Smallcap and midcap stocks plunged up to 4% on Friday, extending a sharp weekly selloff as analysts warned that valuations remain difficult to justify. The Nifty Smallcap 250 index has fallen around 8% this week, while the Nifty Midcap 100 is down 6%, despite a resilient earnings growth outlook.

title: Cyient shares rally 9% after Q2 revenue rises 25%; board declares Rs 12/sh interim dividend
summary: Cyient shares surged on Friday after the company reported a 25% year-on-year rise in consolidated revenue to Rs 2,235 crore in Q2 FY27. Net profit declined 8% to Rs 132 crore. The board declared an interim dividend of Rs 12 per share, while its DET business reported stronger revenue and order intake.

title: Nippon Silver ETF, other silver ETFs slide up to 4% as silver prices tumble. Here’s why
summary: Silver ETFs tumble up to 4% as India permits 6,500 metric tonnes of silver imports over six months, raising expectations of easing domestic supply tightness and premiums. Higher interest rates, bond yields and a firm dollar add to pressure on bullion prices.
